result.title: Benchmarking AI risk behaviors
result.summary: We evaluate LLM risk propensities across a range of contexts and task demands. We evaluate models for how risk averse or risk tolerant they are in various conditions, as well as how stable and consistent their behavior is across conditions. We present a toolkit for developing model risk profiles that can be used to predict model behavior and which can be adapted to include new evaluations of risk propensities. We also examine how these properties have changed across model generations and families. We observe that 2026 state-of-the-art models tend to be more stable, more consistent, and more risk neutral than older models. These trends appear to be related; newer models are more stable and consistent because they are more likely to use expected value maximization as a decision procedure.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在多种情境与任务需求下评测 LLM 的风险倾向（风险规避还是风险容忍）及跨条件的行为稳定性与一致性，提出可扩展的风险画像工具包，并比较不同代际与模型家族的变化趋势。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「决策程序是否稳定、是否按期望值最大化行事」的刻画方式，可能为评估 LVR 中「继续 LOOK 还是 STOP」这类不确定性下的决策一致性与停止准则提供可借鉴的指标，但任务本身不涉及视觉证据，联系需核查。
